samples.summary: `CLEARABLE_COLOR_KEYS` is a hand-maintained keyset that omits the third `StoredColor` field (`underlineColor`), with nothing tying future color keys to it
samples.evidence: `InlineStyle` has three StoredColor-typed keys — `color` (types.ts:178), `backgroundColor` (:180) and `underlineColor` (:157) — but `CLEARABLE_COLOR_KEYS = ['color', 'backgroundColor']` covers only two. No picker passes `''` for `underlineColor` today, so this is not a live bug, but the change's own stated rationale ("a fifth surface would reintroduce the bug", todo.md line 26-28) is exactly about keysets drifting from call sites. The repo has precedent for making that obligation explicit (docs/design/slides/slides-font-ooxml-parity.md:179 "Every new field is added to `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` and both …"); the new constant carries no such note, and neither `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE`'s comment nor a design doc mentions it.

samples.summary: The new cross-package "`''` also means clear" inline-style convention is recorded only in code comments and a task file, not in any design doc
samples.evidence: `normalizeStyleClears` widens the documented inline-style contract (previously: clear == key present with `undefined`, per docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:229-233 and the lessons file) and is exported from both `@wafflebase/docs` entry points for the frontend CRDT path. No `docs/design/**` file mentions it; the canonical home would be the Clear-formatting section of docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md (or the inline-style write-path discussion in docs-intent-preserving-edits.md), not a new parallel doc. Small semantic convention, so this is a discipline nit rather than an architecture change — flagging so the panel can judge the threshold.
searchedFor: Grep normalizeStyleClears across repo (only src/tests/task docs)

samples.summary: Helper is added to the Node entry point as well as the browser entry point, though only the frontend browser path consumes it
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/index.ts:43` and `packages/docs/src/node.ts:73` both re-export `normalizeStyleClears`; the only consumers are `packages/docs/src/store/block-helpers.ts` (internal, imports from `../model/types.js`) and `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts` (browser build). The node-side export widens the public surface for no current caller — mirroring the existing `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` dual export is defensible, so purely taste.
